name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
May 27, 2008
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Cantor Larry Kornit, Congregation B'nai Tikvah
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Presentation by Fire Captain Rick Delaney regarding the proposed statue for Fire Station Six. (CC)
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Ordinances on Agenda (CC/BSD/CDC)
C3.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C4.
Connection Fee Study (CC)
C5.
Reimbursement Fees for Supplemental Improvements (CC)
1.
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2008- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Section 13.04.090 of the Vista Municipal Code Regarding Reimbursement Agreements";
2.
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2008- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Section 17.36.060 of the Vista Municipal Code Regarding Reimbursement Agreements"; and
3.
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2008- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Section 19.08.100 of the Vista Municipal Code Regarding Reimbursement Agreements."
C6.
Amend Chapter 19.08 of the Vista Development Code (CC)
C7.
Fiscal Year 2008-2009 Sewer Capacity Fee Charges (CC/BSD)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- ; and
2.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2008- .
C8.
Engineer's Reports and Assessments for Fiscal Year 2008-2009 (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving an Engineer's Report on the City of Vista Lighting and Landscaping District No. 1 assessments for Fiscal Year 2008-2009 and declaring its intent to levy and collect assessments;
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , determining the cost of services and amount of assessment to be imposed on all assessable property within the City of Vista Street Maintenance District No. 1 for Fiscal Year 2008-2009 pursuant to the Benefit Assessment Act of 1982; and
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving an Engineer's Report on the South Melrose Landscape Maintenance District assessments for Fiscal Year 2008-2009 and declaring its intent to levy and collect assessments.
C9.
Collection of Delinquent 2007 Weed Abatement Charges (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , declaring its intent to set a Public Hearing for collection of delinquent weed abatement charges; and
2.
Set June 24, 2008, as the date of the public hearing to levy assessments on the 2008 property tax roll for collection of delinquent 2007 weed abatement charges.
C10.
Collection of Delinquent Mandatory Trash Charges 2007-2008 (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , declaring its intent to set a Public Hearing for collection of delinquent mandatory trash charges; and
2.
Set June 24, 2008, as the date of the public hearing to levy assessments on the 2008 property tax roll for collection of delinquent 2007 mandatory trash charges.
C11.
City Manager Authorized to Approve Amendments to Classification Specifications (CC)
ITEMS REMOVED FROM CONSENT CALENDAR FOR DISCUSSION
DISCUSSION
D1.
Law Enforcement Services Contract (CC)
D2.
Traffic Calming on Shadowridge Drive (CC)
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
California Department of Transportation Vehicle Grant Program (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive public testimony regarding whether any local nonprofit service providers are readily available to provide services in lieu of the Out and About Vista Senior Transportation Program;
2.
In the absence of such providers, direct the City Manager to sign the "Public Agency Certification of No Readily Available Service Providers" and forward the document to the California Department of Transportation as part of its Section 5310 funding application; and
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , authorizing the submission of an application for grant funds for the California Department of Transportation Section 5310 Vehicle Program, and authorizing the City Manager to sign the application on behalf of the City.
PH2.
Zoning Code Amendment for Unpermitted Residential Structures (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive public testimony, and
1.
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2008- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Title 18, Chapter 18.72 of the Vista Development Code with Respect to Certain Unpermitted Single Family Buildings and Accessory Units."
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
